name: Nene Interactive Suicide
source:
Nene Interactive Suicide is an interactive Flash game created by Tom Fulp and the second official entry in the Pico series.

[Edited from the [url=https://pico.fandom.com/wiki/Nene_Interactive_Suicide]Pico Wiki[/url] page]
translation:
《Nene Interactive Suicide》是湯姆・福爾普製作的一款互動式Flash遊戲，也是《Pico》系列的第二部正式作品。

[編譯自[url=https://pico.fandom.com/wiki/Nene_Interactive_Suicide]Pico維基[/url]頁面]
